headline: IHSG Fluctuates, OJK Tests How Strong Indonesia's Insurance Industry Is
summary: Indonesia's financial regulator OJK is monitoring how the weakening Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) could affect the country's insurance industry. The IHSG is described as volatile.
why: The Jakarta Composite Index is Indonesia's main stock benchmark. Insurers hold large investment portfolios, so equity declines can affect their solvency and capital positions.
original_headline: IHSG Bergejolak, OJK Tes Seberapa Kuat Industri Asuransi RI
